title: What a clean escalation contains

steps.title: Classification
steps.body: Which of the five categories the failure falls into, and the evidence for that call.

steps.title: Trace evidence
steps.body: The failing step with its inputs, including referenced memory and variables, and its raw outputs.

steps.title: Reproduction
steps.body: The run that fails, noting that multi-turn chat is supported in debug preview.

steps.title: What you already ruled out
steps.body: Memory scope and model size changes attempted, and their effect.

footnote: Clear, actionable escalations are the stated goal: they help partners resolve customer issues faster and increase trust in production agents.
